# <span id="aanchor511"></span> <span id="aanchor512"></span> Add an Export

Quorum develops custom exports to extract data from FLOWCAL and output it into a text file, such as a TXT or CSV file, that can then feed other systems or be sent to other companies for import.

After a custom export has been created, you can add it to FLOWCAL and run it manually from the Exports menu or run it automatically by creating an export schedule from [Report/Export Scheduling](Report%20Scheduler/Scheduling.md).

An export does not need to be added to FLOWCAL if you will only run it manually from the **Reports** \> **Exports** menu. You will only need to add the export to FLOWCAL if it will be scheduled.

<div class="procedure">

To add a custom export to FLOWCAL:

1.  Copy the export file (**.dll**) into the **Export** directory under the FLOWCAL installation folder everywhere FLOWCAL is installed.
2.  In FLOWCAL, go to **Reports** \> **Add Export**. The Select an Export screen will display. FLOWCAL will attempt to default to the Export folder; if this directory does not display, you will need to navigate to the Export folder located in the FLOWCAL installation folder.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 539;height: 308;" />

1.  When the Export Data Types screen displays, select whether the export is a meter or source export. Custom exports are typically meter exports. If you are not sure, contact <a href="mailto:flowcal.support@quorumsoftware.com" class="InlineLink">Customer Support</a>.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 157;height: 106;" />

1.  Click **OK**. The export will now be available from the **Reports** \> **Exports** menu or the Reports Scheduling screen.

</div>

All FLOWCAL installations include the Grade.dll, GasTextFileExchange.dll, LiquidTextFileExchange.dll, SourceAnalysisExport.dll, StndFieldInsights, StndTIPS, and CrossMonthBalance.dll exports in the Export sub-directory of the FLOWCAL installation folder. (See: [Exports](Exports.md))
